summary: You can now group workspaces by repository!
html:
You can now group workspaces by repository!

OpenAI’s fastest frontier model is now available!

Improvements

  • Workspace titles are now bolded when awaiting question responses or plan review

Fixes

  • Cancelling Claude Code is now faster and more reliable
  • We’ve reduced GitHub polling for workspaces to prevent hitting query quotas
markdown:
You can now group workspaces by repository!
![image](/assets/changelog/media/0.35.2/1770929018501-image.png)

OpenAI’s fastest frontier model is now available!
![image](/assets/changelog/media/0.35.2/1770929018741-image.png)

## Improvements

- Workspace titles are now bolded when awaiting question responses or plan review

## Fixes

- Cancelling Claude Code is now faster and more reliable
- We’ve reduced GitHub polling for workspaces to prevent hitting query quotas
